description: Source code implementing raw RPC transport with TLS disabled, including classes RpcTransportRaw and RpcTransportCtxRaw, and factory methods for creating transport contexts.

classes.name: RpcTransportRaw
classes.description: Implements a raw RPC transport with poll, read, write, and wait functionalities.

classes.name: RpcTransportCtxRaw
classes.description: Provides a context for RPC transport with TLS disabled, capable of creating new transport instances and retrieving certificates.

methods.name: pollRead
methods.description: Peeks into the socket to check if data is available for reading.

methods.name: interruptableWriteFully
methods.description: Writes data fully to the socket, interruptible by fdTrigger, with optional alternative polling.

methods.name: interruptableReadFully
methods.description: Reads data fully from the socket, interruptible by fdTrigger, with optional alternative polling.

methods.name: isWaiting
methods.description: Checks if the socket is in a polling state.

methods.name: newTransport
methods.description: Creates a new RpcTransport instance with the given socket.

methods.name: getCertificate
methods.description: Returns an empty certificate, as TLS is disabled.

methods.name: newServerCtx
methods.description: Creates a new server RPC transport context.

methods.name: newClientCtx
methods.description: Creates a new client RPC transport context.

methods.name: toCString
methods.description: Returns the string 'raw' representing the transport context type.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Factory method to create a new RpcTransportCtxFactoryRaw instance.
